scope: Primary-source literature frequency/timing supplement; no new model, PPA or EDA experiment
null_semantics: No single system clock is asserted across domains; null is unknown/not applicable, never zero.
prior_PAPERS_json_csv: Original documents unchanged; this file provides domain/status-qualified frequency evidence.

papers.name: OPAL
papers.source_version: arXiv v3; header contains placeholders; venue independently verified
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: 核读arXiv v3 §5.2及65nm综合/硬件结果，并对照已有DAC全文；没有据65nm或TOPS/W反推时钟。[原文PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2409.05902v3)
papers.unified_clock_status: not_found_in_reviewed_version; operation latency is not a clock

papers.name: MoNDE
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: §4.1/Table 2及§4.3，PDF第5–6页：28nm脉动阵列以1 GHz综合，片上buffer采用同工艺编译器。该值属于MoNDE NDP，不是A100的实测锁频。[原文PDF](https://jaewoong.org/pubs/dac24-monde.pdf#page=5)

papers.name: UniCAIM
papers.summary_zh: **无统一数字主频；Fig.12(a)示例为Attention计算20 ns＋Top-k筛选2 ns**
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: v1 §IV-A3，PDF第6页，按图例蓝色为Attention、绿色为Top-k；示例为20%剪枝率、512输入/64输出、64 ADC并行。两段是电路/操作延迟，不能把2 ns倒数写成整机500 MHz，或把20 ns写成50 MHz系统时钟。[原文PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.07479v1#page=6)
papers.unified_clock_status: not_found_in_reviewed_version; operation latency is not a clock

papers.name: MBA: Mega-Buffer Architecture Based on 1T1C IGZO eDRAM for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: 用户提供全文§6，PDF第5页明确16×16 PE阵列工作频率。该文在7nm下评估，PE的45nm来源成本经DeepScaleTool缩放；500 MHz是该架构评估的PE条件，不是IGZO eDRAM测试芯片或所有SFU/NoC的共同实测频率。[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1145/3770743.3803981)

papers.name: Kelle
papers.source_version: author camera-ready PDF; arXiv2510.16040v1 used only as parallel text aid
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: §8开头，PDF第9页：RSA、SFU、接口及控制器RTL设为1 GHz，用45nm NanGate库/DC综合。另有65nm存储模型，不能将逻辑时钟视为所有eDRAM访问均一拍完成。[作者原文PDF](https://saiqianzhang.com/gallery/Kelle_Camera_Ready.pdf#page=9)

papers.name: AttAcc
papers.summary_zh: **计算单元频率待核；HBM3接口5.2 Gb/s/pin已确认**
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: §7.1，PDF第10页明确接口速率。本次解析发现部分表格/图形文字编码异常，尚未从原始表格独立确认GEMV/Softmax各自时钟；不将二手数值或接口速率当成本篇已核计算频率。[原文PDF](https://scale.snu.ac.kr/papers/2024-04-Conference-ASPLOS-AttAcc.pdf#page=10)

papers.name: NeuPIMs
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: v3 §8.1/Table 2，PDF第10页，1 GHz列在HBM Organization一侧。不能不加域标签地写成“NPU和PIM全系统统一1 GHz”；NPU阵列时钟仍需另有直接依据。[原文PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2403.00579v3#page=10)

papers.name: CENT / PIM Is All You Need
papers.summary_zh: **7nm CXL控制器投影频率2.0 GHz；28nm综合关键路径1 ns**
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: v3 §6在Table 5前明确二者关系。2 GHz属于跨节点投影的CXL控制器，不是整套GDDR6-PIM实测频率。Table 4另列tCCDS=1 ns等存储时序，不能把它们当同一个时钟；GPU基线还存在随阶段变化的动态频率。[原文§6](https://arxiv.org/html/2502.07578v3#S6)

papers.name: Anda
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: v1 §V-A，PDF第9页：Anda及所比较基线统一该工作频率、峰值吞吐和片上存储；16nm RTL/Genus及网表VCD功耗条件。该值是具体算术架构评估点，不是HBM2接口频率。[原文PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2411.15982v1#page=9)

papers.name: LLMCompass
papers.source_version: preprint v1 figures; final venue verified by official code repository
papers.summary_zh: **Table I：A100 1410 MHz、MI210 1700 MHz、TPUv3 940 MHz；实测MI210锁1400 MHz**
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: v1 Table I，PDF第3页，为硬件描述示例。§III-C脚注2，PDF第5页，对MI210测试另设1400 MHz以减小波动；不能把1700 MHz描述参数与1400 MHz实测条件混写成同一个配置。这是建模/校准平台频率，不是LLMCompass自身有一个芯片主频。[原文PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2312.03134v1#page=3)

papers.name: Splitwise
papers.summary_zh: **本次核读原文未找到明确的测试锁频／运行时钟数值**
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: 原文使用A100/H100等平台实机profiling与服务仿真；GPU型号、功率预算及降功率配置不等于已披露SM工作频率。保留此项缺口，不用厂商boost频率补成测试条件。[原文PDF](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Splitwise_ISCA24.pdf)
papers.unified_clock_status: not_found_in_reviewed_version; operation latency is not a clock

papers.name: DS-CIM
papers.summary_zh: **整宏工作频率未找到；OR-MAC64局部电路延迟0.4 ns**
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: v1 §III-B/Fig.3(b)，PDF第3页给出40nm OR-MAC64延迟；§V/Table III没有提供与全部SNG、PRNG、累加和SRAM路径绑定的统一主频。不能把0.4 ns倒数2.5 GHz当成整个宏的已验证频率；T64/T256是流长，也不是MHz。[原文PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.06724v1#page=3)
papers.unified_clock_status: not_found_in_reviewed_version; operation latency is not a clock

papers.name: ARTEMIS
papers.summary_zh: **无统一数字主频；每subarray执行64个MAC的操作延迟48 ns**
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: 原文§II背景讨论，PDF第4页，另在电路与数据路径中按具体动作计时。48 ns包含所述操作序列，不是SC单个随机bit时钟；不能用其倒数20.83 MHz标作整个加速器工作频率。[原文PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2407.12638#page=4)
papers.unified_clock_status: not_found_in_reviewed_version; operation latency is not a clock

papers.name: SCARLET
papers.summary_zh: **系统评估设定5 GHz；O–E转换5 GS/s**
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: §IV-A，PDF第5页，作者为反映外围约束采用5 GHz，低于所引用OPCM器件18 GHz演示值；O–E转换为5 GS/s。5 GHz是架构模型设定，不是本篇整芯片实测，18 GHz也不能替代该设定。[原文PDF](https://www.bu.edu/peaclab/files/2026/03/SCARLET_CameraReady.pdf#page=5)

papers.name: Hybrid Systolic Array (HSA)
papers.evidence_location_and_limit_zh: v1 Table II及结论，28nm后布局仿真工作点。原文将500 MHz与该HSA实现的性能/功率结果关联；不能拿表内其他方案20–400 MHz等范围当成本方案频率。[原文Table II](https://arxiv.org/html/2507.09010v1#S5.T2)

papers.name: SANTA / S²ANTA
papers.summary_zh: **v2未找到明确的GPU锁频／运行时钟数值**
